THE BURR

I am a little man who lives in your house;
And I have no right to live there but by stealth;
Yet you are fond of me, my friends are with us,
And some one calls me 'a good fellow'!

There is nothing queer about that except this--
That when we all get together I'm not seen!
The moment you look round for me you shall find me--
For my place is always at the end of the line!
